title: Episode 5
summary: An actor is poisoned during a live show
method: The victim was known to bite his nails so the nail polish was poisoned. A lozenge full of poison was dissolved in the rum bottle that the actors drank from. When the actors drank from the bottle during the performance, the lozenge was still intact so they weren’t affected.
motive: The killer found out that she was going to be dumped.
